heat_smashes.properties_en: Startup: i10–i14 | Block: -9 (Safe) | Punishes any -10 to -14 move on reaction with full cinematic heat damage
heat_smashes.properties_ur: Startup: i10–i14 | Block: -9 (Safe) | Opponent ke har -10 se -14 move ko reaction par full damage se punish karta hai
heat_smashes.counter_strategy: Never throw unsafe pokes or -10 checks when these fighters are in Heat. Jack-8's Heat Smash is an i10 jab-speed punisher! Block is safe (-9), so do not attempt heavy launch punish; take your turn back with an i10 jab check.
heat_smashes.counter_strategy_en: Never throw unsafe pokes or -10 checks when these fighters are in Heat. Jack-8's Heat Smash is an i10 jab-speed punisher! Block is safe (-9), so do not attempt heavy launch punish; take your turn back with an i10 jab check.
heat_smashes.counter_strategy_ur: Jab yeh fighters Heat mein hon toh unsafe attacks ya -10 moves bilkul na karein. Jack-8 ka Heat Smash i10 jab ki speed se aata hai! Block par yeh -9 (Safe) hain, heavy launch punish ki koshish na karein.
heat_smashes.danger_and_counter: Jack-8 (i10) aur Steve (i12) frame punishers hain. Block par -9 safe hain, is liye patient guard rakhein.

heat_smashes.properties: Hit Level: Low | Block: -14 to -15 (Full Launch Punishable) | Pierces standing guard completely
heat_smashes.properties_en: Hit Level: Low | Block: -14 to -15 (Full Launch Punishable) | Pierces standing guard completely

heat_smashes.counter_strategy_en: These Heat Smashes hit Low! If you stand guard, you take 50+ unscaled damage. Read the startup timing or visual crouch dash cue and hold d/b (Crouch Guard). On block, they are -14 to -15: execute your character's optimal While Standing launcher (ws2, ws1,2, or hopkick) for a full round-winning launch combo!
heat_smashes.counter_strategy_ur: Yeh Heat Smashes Low hain! Agar aap khare block karenge toh poora damage lag jayega. Inke aate hi d/b (Crouch Guard) hold karein—block hone par yeh -14 se -15 Launch Punishable hain, apne character ka best While Standing (WS) launcher maarein!
heat_smashes.danger_and_counter: Low hit level pierces standing block. Crouch block grants guaranteed WS launch punish.

heat_smashes.category_ur: Door Se Aane Wale / Projectile Heat Smashes
heat_smashes.characters: Devil Jin (Psyche Laser), Victor Chevalier (Pistol Shot), Alisa Bosconovitch (Rocket Thruster), Jun Kazama (Light Beam), Clive Rosfield (Eikonic Flame), Raven (Shadow Clone Warp), Kunimitsu (Kunai Warp)
heat_smashes.advantage_on_block: -9 (Safe) at Fullscreen / Huge Whiff Punish Threat
heat_smashes.properties: Range: Range 3.0+ to Fullscreen | Hit Level: Mid or High/Mid | Evades neutral keepout
heat_smashes.properties_en: Range: Range 3.0+ to Fullscreen | Hit Level: Mid or High/Mid | Evades neutral keepout
heat_smashes.properties_ur: Range: Poori Screen (Range 3.0+) | Hit Level: Mid ya High/Mid | Neutral mein door se punish karta hai
heat_smashes.counter_strategy: Never whiff attacks at long range when these fighters have Heat active! Jun and Clive can punish any whiff from across the entire arena. Maintain patient standing guard; linear projectiles like Devil Jin's laser and Victor's pistol can also be stepped with SSL/SSR outside close range.
heat_smashes.counter_strategy_en: Never whiff attacks at long range when these fighters have Heat active! Jun and Clive can punish any whiff from across the entire arena. Maintain patient standing guard; linear projectiles like Devil Jin's laser and Victor's pistol can also be stepped with SSL/SSR outside close range.
heat_smashes.counter_strategy_ur: Fullscreen par whiff karne ki ghalti hargiz na karein! Jun, Clive aur Victor poori screen ke doosre kone se whiff punish kar dete hain. Patient guard rakhein aur Devil Jin ke laser ko SSL karke dodge karein.
heat_smashes.danger_and_counter: Fullscreen coverage snipes whiffs. Stay grounded and step linear beams at range.

heat_smashes.category_en: Massive Plus-on-Block into Stance Mixup (+6 to +12 on Block)

heat_smashes.counter_strategy_ur: Inka Heat Smash block karne ke baad kabhi normal buttons na dabayein! Yeh block par +6 se +12 hote hain aur automatic stance mein chale jaate hain. Tod: 2+3 (Raw Heat Burst) ya Power Crush use karein warna patient guard rakhein.

heat_smashes.characters: King (+10 into Jaguar Sprint JGS throw mixup), Nina Williams (+6 gunshot throw sequence), Jack-8 (Tackle cancel), Sergei Dragunov (Tackle / Floor Break loop), Armor King (+10 Shadow Step throw)
heat_smashes.properties: Properties: Triggers automatic cinematic throw transition or +10 sprint into unbreakable grapple
heat_smashes.properties_en: Properties: Triggers automatic cinematic throw transition or +10 sprint into unbreakable grapple
heat_smashes.properties_ur: Properties: Block hone par bhi automatic throw transition ya +10 unbreakable grapple sequence chalta hai
heat_smashes.counter_strategy: King's Heat Smash deals 65 raw damage and enters Jaguar Sprint (JGS) at +10 where an unbreakable throw can land. You must Sidestep Right (SSR) or jab float the sprint on reaction! For Nina, duck the high gunshot follow-up to launch.
heat_smashes.counter_strategy_en: King's Heat Smash deals 65 raw damage and enters Jaguar Sprint (JGS) at +10 where an unbreakable throw can land. You must Sidestep Right (SSR) or jab float the sprint on reaction! For Nina, duck the high gunshot follow-up to launch.
heat_smashes.counter_strategy_ur: King ka Heat Smash 65 damage deta hai aur block hone par seedha Jaguar Sprint (+10) mein aata hai jahan se unbreakable throw lag sakta hai—foran Sidestep Right (SSR) karein ya jab float karein!
heat_smashes.danger_and_counter: Blocks trigger grapple sequences. Sidestep the sprint or duck the follow-up.

movement_bible.technique_ur: Korean Backdash (KBD — Mehfooz Aur Tez Spacing)
movement_bible.input: b, n, b, d/b, b, n, b...
movement_bible.input_execution: b, n, b, d/b, b, n, b, d/b, b...
movement_bible.socd_shortcut: Hold Back (B), then rhythmically tap Down (D) + Forward (F)
movement_bible.socd_shortcut_en: Hold Back (B), then rhythmically tap Down (D) + Forward (F)
movement_bible.socd_shortcut_ur: Back (B) hold rakhein, aur rhythm ke sath Down (D) + Forward (F) tap karein
movement_bible.why: Normal backdash (b,b) has an ending recovery window where you cannot block. Inputting d/b puts your character into a 1-frame crouch state that immediately cancels backdash end-lag, while releasing d/b to neutral registers a free 'b' input from the neutral buffer, allowing seamless infinite backdashing in constant guard state.
movement_bible.why_en: Normal backdash (b,b) has an ending recovery window where you cannot block. Inputting d/b puts your character into a 1-frame crouch state that immediately cancels backdash end-lag, while releasing d/b to neutral registers a free 'b' input from the neutral buffer, allowing seamless infinite backdashing in constant guard state.
movement_bible.why_ur: Aam backdash (b,b) ke aakhir mein recovery pause hota hai jahan block nahi ho sakta. d/b (crouch) karne se backdash ki recovery foran cancel ho jati hai aur release karte hi neutral se agla backdash guard state mein nikalta hai.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown: 1. Double tap back (b, B) to start first backdash. 2. Slide thumb/lever to d/b to cancel recovery. 3. Release to neutral (n) — the engine sees b -> n. 4. Tap b again: the engine registers [b, n, b] and executes the next backdash. Repeat [d/b, n, b] indefinitely.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown_en: 1. Double tap back (b, B) to start first backdash. 2. Slide thumb/lever to d/b to cancel recovery. 3. Release to neutral (n) — the engine sees b -> n. 4. Tap b again: the engine registers [b, n, b] and executes the next backdash. Repeat [d/b, n, b] indefinitely.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown_ur: 1. Pehla backdash b, B karein. 2. Thumb/lever ko d/b par slide karke recovery cancel karein. 3. Release to neutral karein. 4. Dobara b tap karein: engine [b, n, b] read karke agla backdash chala dega. Rhythm: [b, b] -> [db, n, b] -> [db, n, b].
movement_bible.tactical_use: Creates instant whiff punish opportunities at Range 1.5 to 2.5. Forces aggressive opponents to whiff attacks in neutral, leaving them wide open for your launcher.
movement_bible.tactical_use_en: Creates instant whiff punish opportunities at Range 1.5 to 2.5. Forces aggressive opponents to whiff attacks in neutral, leaving them wide open for your launcher.
movement_bible.tactical_use_ur: Range 1.5 se 2.5 par opponent ke attacks ko whiff karwata hai, jahan se aap apna optimal launcher maar kar 70+ combo le sakte hain.
movement_bible.warning: CRITICAL BACKSWAY WARNING: For backsway characters (Bryan, Paul, Nina, Steve, Lee), NEVER use a sloppy qcb (d, d/b, b) motion! A 'd' input will accidentally trigger Backsway stance and leave you completely vulnerable. Use the clean b -> d/b -> b method, or the reverse sway shortcut (b, b, u/b).
movement_bible.warning_en: CRITICAL BACKSWAY WARNING: For backsway characters (Bryan, Paul, Nina, Steve, Lee), NEVER use a sloppy qcb (d, d/b, b) motion! A 'd' input will accidentally trigger Backsway stance and leave you completely vulnerable. Use the clean b -> d/b -> b method, or the reverse sway shortcut (b, b, u/b).
movement_bible.warning_ur: KHABARDAAR (Backsway Characters): Bryan, Paul, Nina, Steve, aur Lee ke sath ghalti se qcb (d, db, b) motion na karein warna Backsway nikal aayega aur aap launch ho jayenge! Clean b -> db -> b ya b, b, ub use karein.

movement_bible.technique: Mishima Wavedash & Crouch Dash Cancel (CD Cancel)
movement_bible.technique_en: Mishima Wavedash & Crouch Dash Cancel (CD Cancel)
movement_bible.technique_ur: Mishima Wavedash Aur CD Cancel Loop
movement_bible.input: f, n, d, d/f, f, n, d, d/f...
movement_bible.input_execution: f, n, d, d/f, f, n, d, d/f, f...
movement_bible.socd_shortcut: Tap F, tap D, then hold D while pressing F to slide into d/f
movement_bible.socd_shortcut_en: Tap F, tap D, then hold D while pressing F to slide into d/f
movement_bible.socd_shortcut_ur: Forward tap karein, Down tap karein, phir Down hold karke Forward dabayein
movement_bible.why: Wavedash closes distance at blistering speed while continually realigning your character to track the opponent's sidesteps. It places the opponent into mental freeze due to the threat of the lethal Mishima 50/50 mixup (EWGF / Mid vs Hellsweep).
movement_bible.why_en: Wavedash closes distance at blistering speed while continually realigning your character to track the opponent's sidesteps. It places the opponent into mental freeze due to the threat of the lethal Mishima 50/50 mixup (EWGF / Mid vs Hellsweep).
movement_bible.why_ur: Wavedash nihayat tezi se distance cover karta hai aur opponent ke sidesteps ko auto-realign karta hai, jis se opponent 50/50 mixup (Hellsweep vs Mid) ke khauf se freeze ho jata hai.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown: 1. Input Crouch Dash: f, n, d, d/f. 2. Slide d/f to forward (f) to cancel the crouch dash into a forward dash. 3. Input neutral then immediately repeat: n, d, d/f, f... Repeat rhythmically for smooth fluid waves.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown_en: 1. Input Crouch Dash: f, n, d, d/f. 2. Slide d/f to forward (f) to cancel the crouch dash into a forward dash. 3. Input neutral then immediately repeat: n, d, d/f, f... Repeat rhythmically for smooth fluid waves.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown_ur: 1. Pehle Crouch Dash karein: f, n, d, df. 2. df ko slide karke f par le jayein jo crouch dash ko forward dash mein cancel karta hai. 3. Neutral karke dobara d, df, f karein. Tezi se loop karein.
movement_bible.tactical_use: Wavedash into Block (CD~B): While wavedashing, suddenly tap and hold Back (B). The opponent anticipates an attack and executes an unsafe panic move which whiffs right in front of your guard! Wavedash into WS: Tap Up (u) or Back (b) during crouch dash to immediately access While Standing launchers (e.g. Kazuya WS+2).
movement_bible.tactical_use_en: Wavedash into Block (CD~B): While wavedashing, suddenly tap and hold Back (B). The opponent anticipates an attack and executes an unsafe panic move which whiffs right in front of your guard! Wavedash into WS: Tap Up (u) or Back (b) during crouch dash to immediately access While Standing launchers (e.g. Kazuya WS+2).
movement_bible.tactical_use_ur: Wavedash into Block (CD~B): Wavedash karte hue achanak Back hold kar lein—opponent dar kar keepout attack marega jo block ya whiff ho jayega! Wavedash into WS: Wavedash mein u tap karke foran WS moves (jaise Kazuya WS+2) maar sakenge.
movement_bible.warning: Do not wavedash in close range without blocking (CD~B); opponents can interrupt raw wavedashes with fast i10 jabs or hopkicks.
movement_bible.warning_en: Do not wavedash in close range without blocking (CD~B); opponents can interrupt raw wavedashes with fast i10 jabs or hopkicks.
movement_bible.warning_ur: Close range mein bina block kiye wavedash na karein; opponent i10 jab ya hopkick se interrupt kar sakta hai.

movement_bible.technique: Crouch Cancel (CC — Standing Launchers from Crouch)
movement_bible.technique_en: Crouch Cancel (CC — Standing Launchers from Crouch)
movement_bible.technique_ur: Crouch Cancel (CC — Crouch Se Standing Launcher)
movement_bible.input: In Full Crouch (FC) -> tap u, n (or f, n) -> Standing Move
movement_bible.input_execution: FC -> u, n -> Standing Move (e.g. cc EWGF, cc df+2)
movement_bible.socd_shortcut: Tap Up (U) for 1 frame to snap to neutral standing instantly
movement_bible.socd_shortcut_en: Tap Up (U) for 1 frame to snap to neutral standing instantly
movement_bible.socd_shortcut_ur: Up (U) ko 1 frame ke liye tap karein jo foran standing position deta hai
movement_bible.why: When you block a heavy low attack, you are left in full crouch (FC). Many characters have mediocre While Standing (WS) launchers but possess god-tier standing launchers (e.g. Mishima cc EWGF, Bryan cc Jet Upper f,b+2, Paul cc df+2). Crouch Cancel lets you bypass WS recovery in exactly 1 frame.
movement_bible.why_en: When you block a heavy low attack, you are left in full crouch (FC). Many characters have mediocre While Standing (WS) launchers but possess god-tier standing launchers (e.g. Mishima cc EWGF, Bryan cc Jet Upper f,b+2, Paul cc df+2). Crouch Cancel lets you bypass WS recovery in exactly 1 frame.
movement_bible.why_ur: Jab aap opponent ka heavy low block karte hain toh aap crouch state mein hote hain. Kuch characters ke WS moves weak hote hain lekin standing launchers (EWGF, Jet Upper) bohot powerful hote hain. CC se aap 1 frame mein standing moves nikaal sakte hain.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown: While blocking in crouch or recovering from a low hit, tap Up (u) or Forward (f) for exactly 1 frame, release to neutral, and immediately input your standing launcher (e.g. u, n, f,b+2 for Bryan Jet Upper or u, n, f,n,df+2 for Mishima EWGF).
movement_bible.execution_breakdown_en: While blocking in crouch or recovering from a low hit, tap Up (u) or Forward (f) for exactly 1 frame, release to neutral, and immediately input your standing launcher (e.g. u, n, f,b+2 for Bryan Jet Upper or u, n, f,n,df+2 for Mishima EWGF).
movement_bible.execution_breakdown_ur: Crouch block ke foran baad Up (u) ya Forward (f) ko sirf 1 frame ke liye tap karein, neutral release karein, aur foran standing launcher input karein (jaise cc EWGF ya cc df+2).
movement_bible.tactical_use: Max-damage punishment on heavy -15 to -20 stagger lows (e.g. Kazuya Hellsweep, Bryan Snake Edge, Law Dragon Tail). Delivers 15-20 more combo damage than standard WS twin pistons.
movement_bible.tactical_use_en: Max-damage punishment on heavy -15 to -20 stagger lows (e.g. Kazuya Hellsweep, Bryan Snake Edge, Law Dragon Tail). Delivers 15-20 more combo damage than standard WS twin pistons.
movement_bible.tactical_use_ur: Bhaari lows (Snake Edge, Hellsweep) block karke standard WS punisher ki jagah standing launcher maar kar round-ending 80+ damage combo lein.
movement_bible.warning: Holding 'u' too long will cause your character to jump. It must be a crisp 1-frame micro tap.
movement_bible.warning_en: Holding 'u' too long will cause your character to jump. It must be a crisp 1-frame micro tap.
movement_bible.warning_ur: Up ko hold na karein warna character hawa mein jump kar jayega; sirf aik halka sa micro tap karein.

movement_bible.technique: Instant While Running (iWR — Point-Blank Running Moves at Range 0)
movement_bible.technique_en: Instant While Running (iWR — Point-Blank Running Moves at Range 0)
movement_bible.technique_ur: Instant While Running (iWR — Point-Blank Running Moves)
movement_bible.input: f, n, f, F + Button (e.g. iWR+2, iWR+3,2, iWR+2+4)
movement_bible.input_execution: f, n, f, F+2 (buffered at Range 0)
movement_bible.socd_shortcut: Tap F, tap F, hold F + Attack button with strict rhythmic cadence
movement_bible.socd_shortcut_en: Tap F, tap F, hold F + Attack button with strict rhythmic cadence
movement_bible.socd_shortcut_ur: Forward tap, Forward tap, phir Forward hold + Attack button dabayein
movement_bible.why: While Running (WR) moves are among the strongest offensive tools in Tekken 8 (e.g. Dragunov wr2, Claudio wr2, Victor wr2, Azucena wr3,2, King Shining Wizard f,f,F+2+4). iWR enables you to execute these moves directly in your opponent's face at Range 0.
movement_bible.why_en: While Running (WR) moves are among the strongest offensive tools in Tekken 8 (e.g. Dragunov wr2, Claudio wr2, Victor wr2, Azucena wr3,2, King Shining Wizard f,f,F+2+4). iWR enables you to execute these moves directly in your opponent's face at Range 0.
movement_bible.why_ur: While Running (WR) moves Tekken 8 ke sabse khatarnak plus-frame weapons hain (jaise Dragunov wr2, Claudio wr2, King Shining Wizard). iWR se aap zero distance (point-blank) par bhi running moves nikaal sakte hain.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown: Tekken 8 allows input buffering: tap forward (f), release to neutral (n), tap forward (f), then press and hold forward on the 3rd tap alongside the attack button (f, n, f, F+Button). Rhythm: 'tap... tap-HOLD+2'.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown_en: Tekken 8 allows input buffering: tap forward (f), release to neutral (n), tap forward (f), then press and hold forward on the 3rd tap alongside the attack button (f, n, f, F+Button). Rhythm: 'tap... tap-HOLD+2'.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown_ur: Tekken 8 mein buffer aasan hai: pehla f dabayein, neutral, doosra f dabayein, aur teesre f par forward hold karke attack button dabayein. Rhythm: 'f... f, F+2'.
movement_bible.tactical_use: Forces massive plus frames on block (+5 to +7) directly in neutral or after blocked jabs. King players use iWR to execute instant Shining Wizard (f,f,F+2+4) anywhere on screen.
movement_bible.tactical_use_en: Forces massive plus frames on block (+5 to +7) directly in neutral or after blocked jabs. King players use iWR to execute instant Shining Wizard (f,f,F+2+4) anywhere on screen.
movement_bible.tactical_use_ur: Point-blank range par opponent ke guard par +5 se +7 plus frames force karta hai. King players screen ke kisi bhi hissay se instant Shining Wizard lagate hain.
movement_bible.warning: If you press the attack button before holding the 3rd 'f', you will get a generic f+2 or f,f+2 instead of the While Running move.
movement_bible.warning_en: If you press the attack button before holding the 3rd 'f', you will get a generic f+2 or f,f+2 instead of the While Running move.
movement_bible.warning_ur: Agar teesre forward se pehle button dab gaya toh normal f+2 ya ff+2 nikal aayega aur WR move nahi banega.

movement_bible.technique: Defensive Option-Select: Sidestep to Guard (SS~B & SS~d/b)
movement_bible.technique_en: Defensive Option-Select: Sidestep to Guard (SS~B & SS~d/b)
movement_bible.input: u (or d) tap for 6f~8f -> immediately hold B (or d/b)
movement_bible.input_execution: u ~ B (SSL to Guard) / d ~ B (SSR to Guard)
movement_bible.socd_shortcut: Tap Up/Down, then immediately transition to holding Back
movement_bible.socd_shortcut_en: Tap Up/Down, then immediately transition to holding Back
movement_bible.socd_shortcut_ur: Up/Down tap karein aur foran Back hold kar lein
movement_bible.why: Raw sidestepping is risky: if the opponent throws a tracking/homing attack, you take counter-hit damage. SS~B (Sidestep Cancel into Guard) gives you the lateral evasion of a sidestep against fast linear pokes while guaranteeing you block slower homing moves or mids.
movement_bible.why_en: Raw sidestepping is risky: if the opponent throws a tracking/homing attack, you take counter-hit damage. SS~B (Sidestep Cancel into Guard) gives you the lateral evasion of a sidestep against fast linear pokes while guaranteeing you block slower homing moves or mids.
movement_bible.why_ur: Seedha sidestep karne se agar opponent homing attack kare toh hit lag jati hai. SS~B se aap sidestep ka dodge bhi le lete hain aur foran back hold karke homing ya tracking moves ko block bhi kar lete hain.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown: Tap 'u' or 'd' to initiate the sidestep. After 6 to 8 frames of lateral movement, immediately transition your hand to hold Back (B). If the opponent pressed a linear move (e.g. Dragunov wr2, Mishima EWGF), it whiffs clean. If they threw a homing move (i18+), you block it safely.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown_en: Tap 'u' or 'd' to initiate the sidestep. After 6 to 8 frames of lateral movement, immediately transition your hand to hold Back (B). If the opponent pressed a linear move (e.g. Dragunov wr2, Mishima EWGF), it whiffs clean. If they threw a homing move (i18+), you block it safely.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown_ur: u ya d tap karein. 6 se 8 frames sidestep hone ke baad foran Back (B) hold kar lein. Linear moves whiff ho jayenge aur slow homing moves aapke guard par block ho jayenge.
movement_bible.tactical_use: The single most essential defensive option select in professional competitive Tekken. Neutralizes 85% of aggressive rushdown without risking counter-hit launches.
movement_bible.tactical_use_en: The single most essential defensive option select in professional competitive Tekken. Neutralizes 85% of aggressive rushdown without risking counter-hit launches.
movement_bible.tactical_use_ur: Professional tournament players ka sabse bara defensive hathyar. 85% linear rushdown attacks ko bina risk liye whiff karwata hai.
movement_bible.warning: Do not cancel the sidestep too early (under 4 frames) or you will cancel before moving off the centerline.
movement_bible.warning_en: Do not cancel the sidestep too early (under 4 frames) or you will cancel before moving off the centerline.
movement_bible.warning_ur: Sidestep ko bohot jaldi cancel na karein (4 frames se pehle) warna character centerline se bahar nahi nikal payega.

movement_bible.technique: Fuzzy Guard & Low Duck Timing (Fuzzy Duck)
movement_bible.technique_en: Fuzzy Guard & Low Duck Timing (Fuzzy Duck)
movement_bible.technique_ur: Fuzzy Guard Aur Low Duck Timing
movement_bible.input: Hold d/b for 3~5 frames -> immediately release to neutral/B
movement_bible.socd_shortcut: Micro-tap Down-Back then return to holding Back
movement_bible.socd_shortcut_en: Micro-tap Down-Back then return to holding Back
movement_bible.socd_shortcut_ur: Down-Back ko 3 frames ke liye tap karke wapas Back par shift karein
movement_bible.why: Strings in Tekken often branch between a fast High extension (e.g. 1,2 or df+1,2) and a slower Mid extension (e.g. df+1,4 or 1,2,3). Fuzzy ducking ducks the fast High on reaction/rhythm and immediately stands up in time to block the slower Mid.
movement_bible.why_en: Strings in Tekken often branch between a fast High extension (e.g. 1,2 or df+1,2) and a slower Mid extension (e.g. df+1,4 or 1,2,3). Fuzzy ducking ducks the fast High on reaction/rhythm and immediately stands up in time to block the slower Mid.
movement_bible.why_ur: Tekken mein strings mein aksar fast High aur slow Mid ka mixup hota hai. Fuzzy ducking se aap fast High ko duck karke guzar dete hain aur foran khare ho kar slow Mid ko block kar lete hain.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown: After blocking the first hit of a string, tap down-back (d/b) for 3-5 frames. If they pressed the fast High, it whiffs harmlessly over your head. If they pressed the delayed Mid, your character stands up before the mid impacts, blocking it safely.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown_en: After blocking the first hit of a string, tap down-back (d/b) for 3-5 frames. If they pressed the fast High, it whiffs harmlessly over your head. If they pressed the delayed Mid, your character stands up before the mid impacts, blocking it safely.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown_ur: Pehla hit block karne ke baad d/b ko 3-5 frames ke liye dabayein. Fast High whiff ho jayega aur slow Mid aane tak aap khare ho kar block kar chuke honge.
movement_bible.tactical_use: Solves knowledge checks against Hwoarang (d+3,4), Nina (d+4,1), Law (b+2,3,4), and Mishima 1,1,2 string pressure.
movement_bible.tactical_use_en: Solves knowledge checks against Hwoarang (d+3,4), Nina (d+4,1), Law (b+2,3,4), and Mishima 1,1,2 string pressure.
movement_bible.tactical_use_ur: Hwoarang d+3,4, Nina d+4,1, aur Law ke multi-hit strings ko neutralize karne ka sabse behtareen tareeqa hai.
movement_bible.warning: Fuzzy timing requires matchup familiarity; ducking too long will cause you to eat the mid launcher.
movement_bible.warning_en: Fuzzy timing requires matchup familiarity; ducking too long will cause you to eat the mid launcher.
movement_bible.warning_ur: Agar zyada der crouch mein rahe toh mid launcher lag jayega; micro timing zaroori hai.

movement_bible.technique: Dash Blocking (f, f, b) & Deep Sidewalking (SS, hold u/d)
movement_bible.technique_en: Dash Blocking (f, f, b) & Deep Sidewalking (SS, hold u/d)
movement_bible.input: f, f, b (Dash Block) / u, u (hold) or d, d (hold) (Sidewalk)
movement_bible.input_execution: f, F ~ b / u, U (hold) / d, D (hold)
movement_bible.socd_shortcut: Forward dash cancelled immediately with Back
movement_bible.socd_shortcut_en: Forward dash cancelled immediately with Back
movement_bible.socd_shortcut_ur: Forward dash ko foran Back se cancel karein
movement_bible.why: Dash Blocking lets you push forward and take stage control without getting hit by keepout attacks (Jet Upper, EWGF, magic 4). Sidewalking (SWL/SWR) provides sustained lateral movement to completely get behind opponents executing long strings.
movement_bible.why_en: Dash Blocking lets you push forward and take stage control without getting hit by keepout attacks (Jet Upper, EWGF, magic 4). Sidewalking (SWL/SWR) provides sustained lateral movement to completely get behind opponents executing long strings.
movement_bible.why_ur: Dash Blocking se aap aage barh kar stage control lete hain bina keepout hits khaye. Sidewalking se aap lambi multi-hit strings ke peeche chale jate hain aur free back-turned launcher milta hai.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown: For Dash Block: Input f, F to start forward run, and after 4-6 frames tap and hold B. For Sidewalk: Tap u or d, then immediately tap and hold u or d to enter sidewalk.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown_en: For Dash Block: Input f, F to start forward run, and after 4-6 frames tap and hold B. For Sidewalk: Tap u or d, then immediately tap and hold u or d to enter sidewalk.
movement_bible.execution_breakdown_ur: Dash block ke liye f, F karke 4 frames baad Back hold karein. Sidewalk ke liye u ya d ko double tap karke hold rakhein.
movement_bible.tactical_use: Cornering passive players at the wall and completely walking around running moves like Dragunov wr2 or Clive sword lunges.
movement_bible.tactical_use_en: Cornering passive players at the wall and completely walking around running moves like Dragunov wr2 or Clive sword lunges.
movement_bible.tactical_use_ur: Opponent ko deewar par dhakelna aur running attacks ke peeche nikal kar full combo lena.
movement_bible.warning: Sidewalking leaves you vulnerable to homing moves; always transition back to block if opponent doesn't attack.
movement_bible.warning_en: Sidewalking leaves you vulnerable to homing moves; always transition back to block if opponent doesn't attack.
movement_bible.warning_ur: Sidewalking ke dauran aap homing moves se hit ho sakte hain; safe rehne ke liye time par block karein.

controllers.pros: Arslan Ash, Atif Butt, Farzeen, Lil Majin, Anakin
controllers.pros_en: Preferred by Arslan Ash, Atif Butt, Farzeen, Lil Majin. Best D-Pad precision for fast sidesteps.
controllers.pros_ur: Arslan Ash, Atif Butt, Farzeen ka pasandeeda controller. Fast sidesteps aur instant throw breaks.
controllers.technique: Claw Grip (index and middle fingers over 1,2,3,4 face buttons) enables instantaneous 1+4, 2+3, and multi-throw breaks.
controllers.cons: Requires Claw Grip for simultaneous 1+4 / 2+3 button presses without macros.
controllers.cons_en: Requires Claw Grip for simultaneous 1+4 / 2+3 button presses without macros.
controllers.cons_ur: Simultaneous 1+4 / 2+3 dabane ke liye Claw Grip (haath ko upar rakhna) zaroori hai.

controllers.pros_en: Preferred by Knee, LowHigh, Ulsan. Rubber grommet returns lever to neutral in 1ms for rapid KBD and Wavedash.
controllers.pros_ur: Knee, LowHigh, Ulsan ka pasandeeda. Rubber grommet lever ko 1ms mein neutral par wapas laata hai.
controllers.technique: Korean Lever (Crown 309MJ / Knee Lever) rubber grommet snaps lever back to Neutral in 1ms for effortless KBD and Wavedash.
controllers.cons: Bulkier travel footprint; requires muscle memory training for clean diagonal inputs.
controllers.cons_en: Heavy form factor; requires muscle memory training for clean diagonal inputs.
controllers.cons_ur: Wazan zyada hota hai aur diagonals (df, db) ke liye haath ki practice darkar hoti hai.

controllers.pros_en: Preferred by Chikurin, Super Akouma. Eliminates physical travel time; 100% consistent 13f PEWGF and 1-button KBD.
controllers.pros_ur: Chikurin, Super Akouma ka pasandeeda. Physical travel time zero hai; 13f PEWGF aur KBD sabse aasan.
controllers.technique: SOCD Cleaning allows holding Back while tapping Down-Forward for lightning-fast 1-button KBD and consistent 13f PEWGF.
controllers.cons: Learning curve for circular inputs (qcf, hcf); strict tournament SOCD rules apply.
controllers.cons_en: Steep initial learning curve for half-circle inputs; requires tournament-legal Neutral SOCD.
controllers.cons_ur: Half circle inputs (qcf, qcb) seekhne mein time lagta hai; official SOCD firmware zaroori hai.

zero_lag_settings.reason: Reduces network input delay. Do not use 'Prioritize Smoothness' as it introduces 2-3 frames of artificial lag.
V-Sync ON adds ~35ms (2+ frames) of display lag, making 20f throw breaks and low reactions nearly impossible.
Ensures rock-solid 60.0 FPS locks on heavy particle stages like Yakushima and Ortiz Farm.
Default sparks obscure opponent arm/shoulder startup animations, preventing accurate visual throw breaks.

blender_emergency_protocol.detail: 1. NEVER press 1,2 Jab after blocking 1,2,3: use df+1 (Mid) or hold block for 1 second. If Law presses d+2,3, it is -15 on block for a full launch punish! 2. Junkyard (b+2,3,4): Low parry (d/f) hit 2 on reaction.
